question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

WITH all_dates AS (
  SELECT CAST(UNNEST(generate_series(date '2020-01-01', date '2020-04-28', INTERVAL '1 day')) AS DATE)::VARCHAR as txn_date
),
daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_ranges AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as first_date, MAX(txn_date) as last_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_dates AS (
  SELECT cr.customer_id, ad.txn_date
  FROM customer_ranges cr
  JOIN all_dates ad ON ad.txn_date >= cr.first_date AND ad.txn_date <= cr.last_date
),
daily_with_net AS (
  SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.txn_date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
  FROM customer_dates cd
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON cd.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND cd.txn_date = dn.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net,
    SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as running_balance
  FROM daily_with_net
),
rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance,
    AVG(running_balance) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id 
      ORDER BY txn_date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_30d_avg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as day_num
  FROM running_balance
),
qualified_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_30d_avg
  FROM rolling_avg
  WHERE day_num >= 30
),
with_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    GREATEST(rolling_30d_avg, 0) as rolling_30d_avg_capped,
    CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) as month
  FROM qualified_avg
),
customer_first_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, CAST(SUBSTR(first_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) as first_month
  FROM customer_ranges
),
with_exclusion AS (
  SELECT wm.*
  FROM with_month wm
  JOIN customer_first_month cfm ON wm.customer_id = cfm.customer_id
  WHERE wm.month != cfm.first_month
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(rolling_30d_avg_capped) as max_avg
  FROM with_exclusion
  GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
monthly_sum AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(max_avg) as total_max_avg
  FROM monthly_max
  GROUP BY month
  ORDER BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(total_max_avg, 2) as total_max_avg
FROM monthly_sum
